subject.title: fix(memory-wiki): propagate deadline signal and skip exhaustive fallback for supplement search

question: Is digest-only retrieval the intended compatibility contract for memory-wiki corpus supplements, even though existing supplement searches may return fewer results after upgrade?
rationale: The fix deliberately trades exhaustive result completeness for bounded latency in a shared plugin supplement path, and repository history does not establish that this product tradeoff is already approved.

options.title: Accept bounded supplement semantics
options.body: Treat corpus supplements as deadline-bounded partial retrieval, retain exhaustive direct wiki search, and require real large-vault proof before merge.

options.title: Preserve supplement completeness
options.body: Keep exhaustive supplement backfill and pursue abort-aware reads, caching, or indexed fallback so upgrade behavior remains complete.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded supplement semantics
recommendation.body: Treat corpus supplements as deadline-bounded partial retrieval, retain exhaustive direct wiki search, and require real large-vault proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the shared corpus bridge and digest fallback whose intended compatibility contract must be confirmed.
